name: SN 1999bd field (Hubble)
blurb: The host galaxy of the superluminous supernova SN 1999bd, seen by Hubble.
label: sn1999bd-hubble
story: Somewhere in this field lies the host galaxy of SN 1999bd, a superluminous supernova of Type IIn. Hubble returned to learn what kind of galaxy gives birth to the most luminous supernovae, and where within it they explode.

claims.text: SN 1999bd is a superluminous Type IIn supernova whose host Hubble imaged
The program surveyed host galaxies of the brightest supernovae
The program aimed to locate the supernovae within their hosts
The program is titled for the most luminous supernovae
